description: Land Acquisition - Karuwakerni, Koralaipattu D/S Division, Batticaloa District
categorisation: This gazette content is a Land Acquisition Notice published under the Land Acquisition Act. It specifically declares that a particular piece of land (with detailed description of its extent and boundaries) is needed for a public purpose and will be acquired. The content focuses entirely on land matters - acquisition, property description, and boundaries - which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4). While it mentions a government minister, this is incidental to the primary land-focused content and does not involve government structural changes or detailed portfolio responsibilities that would trigger a government-related classification.
